messages.text: The weather in Gujarat State, India shows mainly clear conditions with warm temperatures around 25°C. It's quite humid at 82% with light winds from the west-southwest at 13.7 km/h. Rain chances are very low at just 2%, making it a good day for outdoor activities. However, the high humidity may make it feel warmer than the actual temperature, so stay hydrated and consider light, breathable clothing. The evening and early morning hours will be slightly cooler around 24°C, perfect for evening walks or outdoor dining.
